description: exp16 Fase 2 — anchored-decoding arms. All arms use the SAME signed exp11 hibrido top-5 pool (transform=identity); only the prompt/system varies via prompt_variant. Paired within-session vs baseline_repro. New generation under exp16 (allowed).
name: exp16 anchored decoding (prompt-variant arms over the hibrido pool)
context_source: exp11_retrieval194_fullrerank hibrido (identity; prompt/system varies per arm, no re-retrieval)

baseline_repro.hypothesis: Within-session anchor with the canonical prompt (byte-identical to exp12/TierA). H5 drift (+0.033 vs June) forbids reusing TierA baseline across sessions, so it is regenerated here.

anchored_cite.hypothesis: Forcing a per-sentence chunk-number citation [N] and forbidding unsupported statements makes the model self-attribute each claim to evidence. Tests whether explicit attribution raises measured faithfulness (guard against copy-gaming via overlap/length metrics).

strict_abstain.hypothesis: State only what is explicit; omit uncertain details; prefer a short grounded answer. Trades completeness for grounding -> expected higher faithfulness AND higher omission/decline rate (report decline-aware).
